name: Verify episode story packages
on:
  push:
  pull_request:
jobs:
  verify:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
      - name: Check Episode 01 and remaining episode placeholders
        run: python Episode_01/check.py
      - name: Check Episode 01 derived sequential handoff
        run: python Episode_01/sync.py --check
      - name: Check Episode 02 screenplay, prompts, subtitles and assets
        run: python Episode_02/check.py
      - name: Check Episode 02 derived written handoff
        run: python Episode_02/sync.py --check
      - name: Check Episode 03 screenplay, prompts, subtitles and assets
        run: python Episode_03/check.py
      - name: Check Episode 03 derived written handoff
        run: python Episode_03/sync.py --check
      - name: Test episode validation failure cases
        run: python -m unittest discover -s tests -v
